assumptions: No per-user last-active, last-login, or activity/audit log field was documented for staff members, so usage is marked unavailable.
StaffMember does not document a role, creation date, or status beyond the active boolean, so role, createdAt, lastActiveAt and userType are left empty.
Rate-limit numbers and headers were not stated; docs only describe cost-based throttling, so rateLimit fields are left null.
Docs require Plus or Advanced store for read_users; Advanced is used as the minimum plan requirement.
Authentication is documented only as X-Shopify-Access-Token header; OAuth URLs were not provided so only api_key is listed.
Maximum page size of 250 is taken from GraphQL pagination docs and hard-coded as first: 250 in the query.

evidence.quote: Every GraphQL Admin API request carries an access token in the X-Shopify-Access-Token header.
You can retrieve up to a maximum of 250 resources.
The GraphQL Admin API is rate-limited using calculated query costs, measured in cost points.
Staff members are users who can access the Shopify admin
The app must be a finance embedded app or installed on a Shopify Plus or Advanced store.

usage.reason: Source documents only staff profile fields such as email, name and active with no last-active, login, audit log, or per-user report.

body.query: query ($cursor: String) { staffMembers(first: 250, after: $cursor) { nodes { id email firstName lastName name active accountType } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } }

request.readOnlyPostReason: GraphQL Admin API reads use POST but this query only retrieves staff members and changes nothing.
